operation: Update draft PR71 body for current7a/v13 source and exact recovery

structuredContent.body:
This draft integrates #58/#69/#65/#68 while retaining their exact heads as ancestors. It preserves native Texture/Styles production, HDR/gain-map/color/depth facts and original media, adds optional true-directory PVT output, and delivers the complete product on arm64/macOS27. Cross-platform Rust core checks remain. **Merge and branch deletion await final acceptance and parent execution review.**

Changes:
- Preserve coded/display transforms, RGB16/Main10 values, primary/video samples and typed auxiliary graphs; reject unknown or ambiguous resources.
- Require completed GPU/edit-state receipts and real source-derived Styles data; reconstruct HDR before linear reduction and retain the inverse fit.
- Publish pair/PVT without replacing existing output, retain recoverable stages, and protect original-file aliases, opaque packages and checkpoint provenance. Pair stays the default; App delegates to the same Rust option.
- Keep CLI localization compatible with JSON, exit codes and paths. Pin native dependencies, verify the complete dylib closure and exercise relocated arm64 packages outside the checkout.
- Share one complete-data System/Tone consumer, preserve original pinned imports, and validate actual per-interpreter case names and owned-parent containment.
- Verify PVT through a new whole com.apple.live-photo file promise → system Photos save activity → independent PhotoKit resource readback in one owned simulator. Split cold SDK/reader setup, adopt current scene lifecycle, retain bounded native diagnostics and exclude media/xcresult uploads.
- Apply scoped pinned pstack instruction skills through existing owners; no Cursor bootstrap or generic framework.

Current source **7a561de9b2c6573caabae80642ba01d99e07e05f**, tree **602f0859d36dce377b13e1653645ee2b727a775f**.

Validation:
- Current clean Linux gate7/7 PASS, all293 Python tests including actual pinned extractor integration, workspace fmt/clippy/regressions, current CLI and actual pair/PVT roundtrip/no-clobber. Two repeated Linux JPEG CLI encodes are explicitly excluded; native product keeps the complete suite.
- Current [System HEIF](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/actions/runs/39536719321/job/119014935686) PASS:24 consumer regressions and three real168960-component renders, original asymmetric response retained. Current arm64 package and macOS/Linux portability jobs passed; Windows is pending.
- Previous4275 [product/App](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/actions/runs/39528720300/job/118989380416) passed both builds, all30 model calls and32 PVT ancestor/alias combinations. Its absolute Styles median/p959.227/9.588s passed unchanged11.732/15.406s budgets. Same-runner candidate/main ratio1.17990 and CPU9.1/7.9s remain an unresolved relative cost; the negative immutable-validation prototype was not adopted.
- Old4275 System/Tone failed a cross-Python test expectation; a launch marker did not establish escape on modern pathlib. The actual case rule is repaired, without relaxing data acceptance.
- Old simctl directory import returned133/NSPOSIX22 “File type unsupported”; it does not decide Photos/share acceptance. Reader setup also timed out. The new system-sharing entrance, compiler/setup, single Live Photo, original resources/IDs/cover/hashes must actually pass. No decomposed-member/PhotoKit pair creation substitutes, physical Photos editing, wallpaper or unavailable historic sample equivalence are claimed.
- Current [product/App](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/actions/runs/39536719341), [Tone/PVT](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/actions/runs/39536719321), [performance](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/actions/runs/39536719296), [core/package](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/actions/runs/39536719308), [exact-head](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/actions/runs/39536719292) and [real fixtures](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/actions/runs/39536719373) require complete final-head inspection; old passes do not replace them.

[Fixed v13 evidence, author review and32-ref recovery](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/blob/299aef275affd38d66e30d7ff39559678b4e8831/docs/validation/reviews/20261020-semantic-integration/iterations/7a561de/README.en.md) includes exact source receipts, actual App/performance results, attributed PVT native failure and an explicitly disabled convergence plan. All32 durable source refs were independently fetched with exact commit/tree matches, non-shallow full strict fsck0, covering all9 remote heads. Main remains89d806c8; only this source branch advanced.

After final gates and parent review, ordinary-merge71 with its exact expected head, inspect actual indirect merged states and automatic deletion, then approve the fresh exact remaining cleanup set. No merge/delete, force push, release, upstream write, paid/billing or protection/global security change occurred.
